name: Portland
tagline: Food carts, roses and waterfalls on the doorstep
summary: Portland is the Pacific Northwest's quirky, green city, known for food carts, craft beer, coffee and Powell's giant bookstore. Wander the International Rose Test Garden and Japanese Garden, then drive the Columbia River Gorge past Multnomah Falls or head to Mount Hood and the Oregon coast.
seasonNote: Summer is dry and sunny; the rest of the year is mild and drizzly.
arrival: Portland International is 25 minutes from downtown on the MAX Red Line.
gettingAround: MAX light rail, streetcar and bikes; a car for the Gorge.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Food carts, Voodoo-style doughnuts and craft beer.
buyTip: Books at Powell's and tax-free shopping (Oregon has no sales tax).
